capability.title: Guest Reviews
capability.description: Marquee of guest review cards that scrolls continuously and loops seamlessly, with star rating, quote, avatar, name, location detail and favourite dish. Pauses on hover, on keyboard focus, or via a pause control, and stops entirely for reduced-motion users. Renders one h2; guest names and ratings are not headings.
useWhen: The page needs social proof from real guests
avoidWhen: The content is editorial brand storytelling (use a story capability)
